response.justification: Bogdan presents as a highly experienced software craftsman with a strong background in distributed systems, large-scale infrastructure, and cloud technologies like Kubernetes and AWS. His extensive experience in establishing engineering best practices, mentoring, and leading technical initiatives, as evidenced by his workshops and project ownership, aligns well with the technical leadership aspects of the role. While his explicit C++ experience falls short of the minimum requirement, his proficiency in other systems-level languages (Dlang) and broad technical adaptability suggest he could be a strong fit if the C++ requirement has some flexibility or can be quickly acquired.
strengths: Extensive experience with large-scale distributed systems, microservices, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes).
Proven technical leadership, mentoring skills, and a strong commitment to engineering best practices (TDD, CI/CD).
Demonstrated ability to own and drive complex technical projects to completion, including founding an open-source platform.
concerns: Limited recent and explicit professional C++ experience, falling short of the 8-year minimum qualification.
While strong in leadership activities, his resume lacks consistent 'Technical Lead' titles for a sustained period.
Experience leans more towards application/platform layers on cloud rather than deep, low-level 'compute platform' engineering.
